verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API (launched December 2025) covering cards, payments, transactions, and expense data, with webhooks, mTLS/OAuth, and TypeScript/Python SDKs. An official MCP server also exposes card issuance and limits, transaction queries and CSV export, reimbursements, bill pay, and vendor management. However, nothing claims UI parity, and many UI features have no documented programmatic equivalent. Probes also found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of team/user and role/permission management, FX conversion and Jeeves Cash account operations, approval-flow configuration, invoice scanning and accounting-sync controls, a publicly reachable machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.
